blocks.text: Biennial (do saal zinda rehne wale) aur perennial (kai saal zinda rehne wale) podon ko thand (low temperature) mein rakhne se phool dene ka ishara milta hai. Isi ko vernalisation kehte hain. Thand ka yeh ishara (stimulus) pake hue tane ka shoot apex (sira) ya beej ka embryo (bachcha poda) leta hai, patte nahin, jaise photoperiodism mein hota hai.

Kuch podon ke liye vernalisation bilkul zaroori (absolute requirement) hai, jab ke kuch mein yeh sirf phool laane mein madad karti hai. Thand dene (chilling treatment) ki zaroori muddat chaar din se teen mahine tak hoti hai. Taqreeban 4°C ka temperature is kaam ke liye bohat asar-daar paya gaya hai. Thand ek hormone “vernalin” banne ka ishara deti hai jo vernalisation karwata hai. Photoperiodism aur vernalisation podon ke reproduction (nasal barhane) ke waqt ko mahol ke saath mila dete hain, taake saal ke munasib waqt par hi reproduction ho. Yeh is baat ko bhi yaqeeni banate hain ke ek hi species (nasal) ke pode ek hi waqt par phool dein; is se cross pollination (ek pode ke phool ka zar doosre pode tak jana) barhti hai aur genetic variability (nasal mein farq) paida hoti hai.

Pake tane ka shoot apex ya beej ka embryo
Munasib mausam mein phool; ek saath phool se cross pollination

blocks.prompt: Sardiyon wali gandum (winter wheat) bahar (spring) mein boi jaye to ugti to hai magar phool nahin deti, jab ke khizan (autumn) mein boi jaye to agli garmiyon mein phool de deti hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Winter wheat ko vernalisation chahiye: us ke shoot apex ya embryo ko taqreeban 4°C ki thand ka kuch arsa chahiye taake vernalin bane aur poda phool ke qabil ho. Khizan mein bone se use sardiyon ki thand mil jati hai; bahar mein bone se nahin milti, is liye woh sirf patte aur tane banata rehta hai.

items: Vernalisation: thand (taqreeban 4°C, chaar din se teen mahine) se biennial aur perennial podon mein phool aana; thand shoot apex ya beej ka embryo mehsoos karta hai; hormone vernalin. Kuch podon mein lazmi, kuch mein sirf madadgar.
Photoperiodism ke saath mil kar yeh reproduction ko munasib mausam se milati hai aur ek species ke podon mein ek saath phool la kar cross pollination aur genetic variability barhati hai.
